correctness.rationale: For a nonempty finite dual poset P, direct pseudocomplementation yields p∈¬U iff no maximal point above p belongs to U, and p∈¬¬U iff every such maximal point belongs. Hence exactly 2^m DNE fixed upsets. WEM requires monochromatic inclusion of maxima in each connected comparability component, giving W=∏(1+u(P_i\M_i)); the both-count is 2^c, and the remaining two cells and neither-count follow by inclusion–exclusion. For neither=0, one multi-max component C cannot coexist with any nonsingleton other component because DNE-only and WEM-only valuations product to a neither valuation; within C, any p whose maximal cone is a proper subset yields a neither upset. Conversely the claimed two frame configurations exhaust every upset. Independently enumerated all 4473 labeled posets of orders 1–5 and all their upsets, checking the four cells and iff zero-neither classification. Empty/nonempty, chain, fork, and disconnected forks tested; bounded enumeration only corroborates the all-size proof.
